sentences.text: The provided KFS evidence identifies the document as a KFS, but it does not state any pre-payment charge.
The home loan agreement evidence is inconsistent, with one version stating a pre-payment charge of 2% of principal outstanding and another version stating 3% of principal outstanding.
From the materials provided, the KFS and the home loan agreement cannot be confirmed to state the same pre-payment charge.

missing.searched: Reviewed the provided KFS evidence for any stated pre-payment charge; none was shown.
